name: flavorpilot
description: Bilingual culinary flavor-construction platform: Next.js web, NestJS API and shared deterministic Flavor Engine.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:engine
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @flavorpilot/api && npm run build --workspace @flavorpilot/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n contracts,engine,api,web -c auto "npm run dev --workspace @flavorpilot/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @flavorpilot/flavor-engine" "npm run dev --workspace @flavorpilot/api" "npm run dev --workspace @flavorpilot/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @flavorpilot/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @flavorpilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run validate:structure && npm run typecheck && npm run test
